items.title: A surjective non-identity selfmap of a Hausdorff space is covered by a proper closed subset and its image
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the elementary covering lemma used in the section on extremally disconnected spaces (author lemma at source lines 5572-5577, label lemma-rainwater): a surjective selfmap of a Hausdorff space that is not the identity admits a proper closed subset E with X equal to E together with its image. The proof (source lines 5579-5587) is short and explicit: it separates a moved point from its image by Hausdorffness, cuts out the closed complement of a suitable neighbourhood, and then checks the covering property point by point (proof lines 5580-5586). H2.
